fields.name: app_key
fields.help: Your Doudian app's app_key (抖店开放平台 → 应用管理).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: The app's app_secret; it signs every call (hmac-sha256).

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Shop access_token from /token/create (self-built apps: grant_type authorization_self with your shop_id). It lasts about 7 days; renew it with /token/refresh and update this value — the server does not renew it.

me.note: product.listV2 with one product: verifies app_key, signature and the shop access_token.

list_products.note: product.listV2 (seller side: your own shop's products), page from 1, size up to 100. status 0 = online, 1 = offline; check_status 3 = approved. Prices are per SKU (see get_product). `query`/`category` are not applied. product_id values exceed 2^53: the Python server returns them exactly, the TypeScript server may round them — use get_product's product_id_str.

get_product.note: product.detail by product_id: title, images, price (discount_price, in fen: 1990 = ¥19.90), status and spec_prices (SKU prices and stock).

get_order.note: order.orderDetail by shop_order_id: status (order_status_desc), pay_amount in fen, create_time (unix seconds), logistics and SKU lines; buyer data is encrypted by the platform.

track.note: order.orderDetail logistics_info: the parcels (tracking_no, company_name, ship_time) of the order; route events are only available for Douyin e-waybills (logistics.trackNoRouteDetail).

not_offered.quote_shipping: The Doudian Open Platform is the seller-side API of your own shop (https://op.jinritemai.com/docs/guide-docs/10/23): freight is configured in freight templates, there is no shipping-quote call for a product and destination.
not_offered.create_order: Orders are placed by buyers on Douyin; the seller API only reads and fulfils them (order.searchList, order.orderDetail, order.logisticsAdd — https://op.jinritemai.com/docs/api-docs/15/1342), so a supplier order cannot be created.

adapter.terms: 抖店开放平台 (https://op.jinritemai.com/docs/guide-docs/10/23): every call carries method, app_key, access_token, param_json (key-sorted compact JSON, all values strings), timestamp (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, GMT+8), v=2 and sign = hmac-sha256(app_secret, app_secret + sorted name+value pairs + app_secret), where 'access_token和sign_method不参与加密'. Success is code 10000. The shop access_token (about 7 days) must be renewed outside this server.
